gloss: water supply; clean water; tap water

definitions.gloss: water supply; clean water; tap water
definitions.explanation: Clean, treated water supplied through a public water system for drinking and domestic use. Contrasted with {下水|げすい} (sewage/wastewater).

examples.japanese: {上水|じょうすい}の{水質|すいしつ}を{検査|けんさ}する。
examples.english: To inspect the quality of the water supply.

examples.japanese: {上水|じょうすい}と{下水|げすい}のインフラ{整備|せいび}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Infrastructure development for both water supply and sewage is needed.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}では{上水道|じょうすいどう}の{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}が{進|すす}んでおり、{水漏|みずも}れが{頻繁|ひんぱん}に{起|お}きている。
examples.english: In this area, the water supply system is aging, and leaks occur frequently.

notes:
Refers to clean, treated water for human consumption, as opposed to {下水|げすい} (sewage/wastewater). Composed of {上|じょう} (upper/above) + {水|すい} (water). The character {上|じょう} indicates clean/good water, while {下|げ} in {下水|げすい} indicates waste.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上水道|じょうすいどう}: water supply system/waterworks
- {上水|じょうすい}の{水質|すいしつ}: water supply quality
- {上水|じょうすい}{処理|しょり}: water treatment

RELATED WORDS:
- {下水|げすい}: sewage, wastewater — the counterpart to {上水|じょうすい}
- {下水道|げすいどう}: sewage system
- {水道|すいどう}: water supply, plumbing — the general term for tap water infrastructure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {水道水|すいどうすい}: tap water — the everyday word for water from the tap
- {飲料水|いんりょうすい}: drinking water — water safe for drinking

ETYMOLOGY:
The term {上水|じょうすい} has historical roots in Edo-period water supply systems, such as the famous {玉川上水|たまがわじょうすい} (Tamagawa Aqueduct) built in 1653 to supply water to Edo (Tokyo).
